description: Measured on this tree: a newline after a control header (`repeat 3`) selects the long `… end` body form, so the `[` on the next line is not parsed as the short-form body. 1 statement; `ol-missing-end` at parse stage. The `[` on line 2 is parsed as a list literal, not as the body.

params.hint: wrap the body in [ ] or close it with end.
